title: Confirm the Turn
briefing: Tidal Power keeps making lower lows. A bounce will tempt you. Wait for the next candles to confirm before you buy.
objective: Reversal patterns are clues, not promises. Wait for confirmation.
debrief: Tidal Power fell steadily. A bounce on day 6, fuelled by takeover chatter, looked like a turn but failed, and the lower lows continued. Value Vera bought after red candles and kept catching the fall. The real turn came on day 13, when the regulator approved a rate rise and higher closes followed. Waiting for that confirmation avoided the falling knife.

news.headline: Online chatter: is Tidal Power a takeover target?
news.body: Posts online suggest a rival could bid for Tidal Power. Neither company has commented.

news.headline: Regulator approves Tidal Power's rate rise
news.body: Tidal Power can raise the price it charges for electricity by 6% from next month.

basic.text: Don't buy while the downtrend makes lower lows (days 0-12)
Buy once the turn is confirmed
